sample_unit: LLM responses (24 scenarios x 4 prompt formulations x 4 models)

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM safety scores across layperson, detailed, professional, and anxiety-driven prompt phrasings
links.effect: Safety scores did not differ across prompt formulations (χ²(3)=3.40, p=0.334) or models (H=0.17, p=0.982); mean prompt robustness index 0.15; 5/384 responses (1.3%) unsafe.
links.quote: Safety scores did not differ significantly across prompt formulations (χ²(3) = 3.40, p = 0.334) or between models (H = 0.17, p = 0.982).

links.outcome: Output variability of LLM responses under paraphrased prompt formulations
links.effect: Prompt robustness analysis showed low variability (mean prompt robustness index = 0.15); prompt wording changed response length (p=0.0029) but not clinical reliability.
links.quote: Prompt robustness analysis demonstrated low variability (mean prompt robustness index = 0.15).

screen.reason: The study tests LLM sensitivity and safety across different simulated patient prompt formulations in orthodontic scenarios, evaluating baseline model robustness rather than a deployment practice or safeguard.
